description: Anonymized starter pack for newcomers. Import with: .\metra.ps1 setup -Profile .\profiles\sample -Force
notes: Replace operator display name in .cursor/rules/metra-persona.local.mdc after import.
Edit metra.config.json roots and workspace.alwaysInclude for your machine, then re-run .\metra.ps1 setup.
Workspace outputs default to Metra.code-workspace with orchestration folder label Metra.
Work root only in this pack; add a personal/cloud root from docs/Customizing-Metra.md if needed. Personal-root registryFile is not included.
